ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white/grey) patches at the distal ends, approximately an 85:15 black-to-white ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling and speckling localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; central and proximal fluke areas consist of solid low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes along the entire trailing edge boundary, particularly pronounced on the medial sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex sweep from the median notch extending towards the tips, terminating in sharp, upward-tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) visible at the extreme tips of both lobes; scattered focal white points on the black surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the interior black surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization and associated scarring at the distal margins of both fluke lobes.
